sections.Introduction: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland brings Lewis Carroll’s timeless world to life in a spectacular pinball adventure. Inspired by the wonder, imagination and eccentric characters of the original story, Dutch Pinball created a machine that combines the feel of classic 1990s pinball with modern technology, rich detail and striking artwork. Designed to be as much a work of art as a pinball machine, Alice rewards exploration with new details, surprises and experiences every time you play. Production was strictly limited to 500 individually numbered machines worldwide.
sections.Key Features:
- Mini upper playfield with two magna-flippers
- Interactive ball savers at both outlanes
- Laser-cut protectors and metal ball guides
- Extra 3D-sculpted mini IPS LCD display on playfield
- Full RGB interactive side rails (industry first)
- Stumblor board with mobile app for RGB light shows
- Non-reflective translite glass (industry first)
- Direct art-printed mirror blades (industry first)
sections.Download Software:
AAIW v1.05 (Latest - Delta Update) zip Latest Operational Manual pdf 3,1 MB Rulesheet pdf 4,4 MB FAQ Manual pdf 8,9 MB
- 01 Download the .zip file of the update (without renaming or extracting, some browsers like Safari do this automatically, disable that if needed. On Mac, Chrome is recommended).
- 02 Copy the .zip file to the root of a USB stick (not in a subfolder). For faster updates, use an exFAT formatted USB stick instead of FAT32.
- 03 Insert the USB stick in a free USB port of the PC.
- 04 Method 1 (easiest): With USB stick inserted, switch Alice ON. The update will be automatically detected and performed. After the update, Alice will start. Check the version number in the menu.
- 05 Method 2: Enter the Service Menu and go to "Software". Select the update and press Start. The game will restart using the new version.
! After an update (full image or Delta) always flash the topper (last position in Test Menu). This ensures communication with the topper is up to date and prevents freezes during gameplay.
